name: mcp-events
description: Polls MCP Events (events/list, events/poll) on an MCP server's HTTP endpoint and starts a turn when one fires

url.title: MCP endpoint
url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of the server whose events to poll

server.title: Server name
server.description: The server's name in /mcp, used to tell the model whose tools to use

events.title: Event names
events.description: Comma-separated event names to subscribe to; empty: every event the server lists with poll delivery

superseded.title: Superseded event names
superseded.description: Comma-separated event names that are dropped when the model has called one of the server's tools since the event

waitTools.title: Wait tools
waitTools.description: Comma-separated tool names the model is told not to call, because an event resumes it instead

stateTools.title: State tools
stateTools.description: Comma-separated tool names (without the server prefix) whose results show the server's state; a call to one of them means the model has seen everything up to then. A name written tool:kind counts only for events whose data has that kind

ownOnly.title: Own events only
ownOnly.description: Start a turn only for an event whose id starts with the prefix the session's own server reports in its status tool, and tell the model to stop waiting only when that server says it serves events over HTTP

statusTool.title: Status tool
statusTool.description: Tool name (without the server prefix) whose result has events.source, the prefix of the server's event ids, events.http, whether it serves events over HTTP, and events.url, where

relay.title: Endpoint relays every server
relay.description: The endpoint is a reader that relays the events of every server on the machine, so the session's own server is reached there whatever address it serves at
